title: Thandri Deva – Christopher Chalurkar, Ekklesia Telugu Christian Lyrics

credits.Artist: JCGG Ekklesia featuring Christopher Chalurkar, Deepak Dinakar

intro: Thandri Deva is the latest christian Telugu worship single was an original translation from Tamil song, Thagappanaey Thandhayae by Tenny Jinans John, translated by Christopher Chalurkar & Deepak Dinakar and sung by Hyderabad based Christian Ministry, JCGG Ekklesia featuring Christopher Chalurkar, Deepak Dinakar, song mixed & mastered by Enoch Jagan and produced by Prem Samuel. This song was released on December 23, 2020 under JCGG Ekklesia.
